combat+18.notes: PARTLY SOURCED, partly explicit proxy: published Merlin 66 engine 1,705 bhp at 5,750 ft in MS and 1,580 bhp at 16,000 ft in FS. A&AEE BS.543 report records full-throttle heights in FLIGHT at 10,800 and 22,000 ft, not identical to engine test-bed heights; flat-power intervals to flight FTH assume ram recovery. Sea-level +18 bhp 1,600 is a PROVISIONAL estimate, not a published test-bed reading. Above FTH, BHP is scaled from source-observed boost with atmospheric +14.7 psi denominator; this is a proxy, not measured BHP.
